kicker: Vaccination due hai, owner bhool gaya
title: Pet owners *bhoolte* hain. Pet clinic ko nahi bhoolna chahiye.
message:
Hi [naam] 🐾 *[pet ka naam]* ka [vaccine] booster *[date]* ko due hai.
Slot: *[din] 11 am* ya *[din] 5 pm*?
Vaccination card saath laana mat bhoolna.
why: message mein *pet ka naam* = personal lagta hai. Owner ko lagta hai clinic unke pet ko jaanta hai.
caption:
Pet clinic ka sabse bharosemand revenue: vaccination aur booster. Har saal, har pet. Bas owner ko yaad nahi rehta. 🐶🐱

Kaise:
1️⃣ Pehli visit pe pet ka naam + due dates sheet mein
2️⃣ 5 din pehle WhatsApp, pet ke naam ke saath
3️⃣ 2 slot options
4️⃣ Visit ke baad next due date bata do
